correctness.rationale: All finite base cross-edges are frozen. Lu’s switching transformations give binary translation actions on all free cross-edges. Independent row and column restriction ranks, their rank-nullity difference, the all-one case, and the full symmetric case give the exact local quotient formula for every nonnegative base-side size and arity. The left/right balancing equivalence follows by side interchange, with explicit converse from arity one or two. The one-parameter three-coordinate sharp threshold follows from evaluated exact formulas. Independent explicit-mask enumeration reproduced 910 finite group/configuration tests.

value.rationale: Determines a complete natural local invariant and solves an exact reconstruction threshold: unmarked numerical profiles fail to distinguish two groups at all arities, yet a single fixed parameter and three new coordinates distinguish all five; balanced bases preserve a family of all-arity collisions. This is a structural visibility transition with sharp bounds, not simply a numerical extension or isolated small count.
